about: Gate D.3 poll result vectors (V3.2 execution plan §4, D-47). Results are computed once, after the poll closes, from per-block answer counts and the eligible households per block. Defaults: at least 3 answers and an audience of at least 5 households for any shown grouping; a block is shown only when the rest of the audience (site - block, and all hidden blocks together) also qualifies.

cases.name: two answers: not enough responses to show anything
enough answers but an audience of four households: nothing shown
both blocks qualify and so does each remainder: site and both blocks shown
site minus block: block B has only 2 answers, so block A (whose remainder is B) is hidden too
a block of four households is never shown, nor its complement
adjacent groupings: with three blocks, the hidden ones together must also qualify
an audience of one block: only the total is shown (the block equals the site)
a tenant may raise the thresholds (never lower): 5 answers under a threshold of 6 shows nothing
